definition: Signal = maximum intensity of each frame at 990-1012 cm-1, background = mean of each frame at 1800-2000 cm-1. Slopes are per frame_index unit.
design: The background was added as a uniform offset over the whole range, so it gives the same slope wherever it is measured (minimum, median, 1800-2000 mean). The background rise (50) was kept at 7 percent of the signal drop (750), so measuring the "signal" without background correction deviates by only 6.7%.
note: The file has a frame_index column, so load_spectrum rejects it (by design). It must be read with run_analysis(file_ids=[...]).
